name: Pucci
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $1462 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's printed silk dresses, shirts, jersey separates, swimwear and scarves, dresses roughly $2,000–$4,000, sold through its own boutiques, site and department stores.
origin: Founded in Florence, Italy in 1947 by Emilio Pucci.

ownership.owner: LVMH Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton (Euronext Paris: MC)

quote.q: He dressed such women with easy, immediate pieces that express a new idea of elegance: fast, joyful, spontaneous, effortless.

opview: “He dressed such women with easy, immediate pieces that express a new idea of elegance: fast, joyful, spontaneous, effortless.” — Pucci (house), About Us, pucci.com

facts_read.source: brand site; lvmh.com Maison page; neimanmarcus.com search; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database

price_read.sublines: Pucci women's ready-to-wear and shoes; EXCLUDED: Pucci Junior (kids; tagged 'junior kids', 119 products incl. $120-250 tees and shirts), swimwear, scarves, stoles, accessories, long kaftans

doors.note: US section lists 4: Palm Beach, Miami Design District, Houston, Woodbury outlet. Global list also covers Italy (incl. La Rinascente concession, Portofino seasonal), France, UK, Brazil, Asia, Japan, Middle East.

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 across 15 house category tags, proportional; 371 styles from 411 listings in /en-us/collections/view-all-ready-to-wear/products.json; un

tech_evidence.names: Tecno Poudre (house cloth name, 100% polyester; no performance claim found); Lycra named as a cloth on jersey styles
tech_evidence.owned: own cloth name (Tecno Poudre); Lycra licensed
tech_evidence.share: under 5% (1 of 80 sampled names Tecno Poudre; 'super-stretch' cady/jacquard claims on a few more)

craft_evidence.owned: no — no factory or workshop named on the brand's pages
craft_evidence.mills: no — PDPs name the cloth (silk twill, cady, crêpe de Chine) but no mill
craft_evidence.madein: 98% (78 of 80 sampled: 77 Italy, 1 India; 2 state nothing)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed — founded 1947 by Emilio Pucci, Marquis of Barsento; first boutique Capri 1950; native Florence
craft_evidence.process: no — archive prints redrawn with 'a new design process that respects the imperfection of the handcrafted'; no making process published
craft_evidence.reasoning: Country of make (Italy) is on nearly every product page and the founding is dated and placed (1947, Florence and Capri). The brand names no workshop, maker or silk mill, and the about page talks about print design, not how the clothes are made, so it scores 2 on the evidence.
